name: Canadian Open Government Portal
tagline: Government of Canada open data and information via CKAN and public REST APIs.
description: Public APIs for searching, browsing, and downloading Government of Canada open datasets and related open information. Built primarily on CKAN Action API endpoints with portal search, package metadata, and resource access for developers and agents.

auth.details: Public read endpoints require no authentication; write/admin actions (if any) are not for public self-serve use.

use_cases: search Government of Canada open datasets by keyword
fetch package metadata for a known dataset id
list resources and download URLs for an open dataset
discover recently updated federal open data packages
